title: Essence of the Transmission
subtitle: Test your understanding of the Great Spiritual Awakening — the matrix overlays, density suppression, the three strings, and the path home.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Essence of the Transmission is the cornerstone of the Great Remembering. Every answer you held — and every one you missed — is an invitation to uninstall another layer of the 3rd-density overlay. Return to the deep-dive when you need the map again, the infographics, and the video transmissions. Anchor yourself in the three severing strings, the architecture of the realm, and the coming EMF restoration. You are not learning a new belief system; you are recovering memory.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Essence of the Transmission deep-dive

questions.question: Which specific density level was the original crystalline paradise of our realm, before it was invaded and suppressed?

options.label: A
options.text: 4th-density
options.rationale: This is the density of the parasitic entities who engineered the overlay, not the original state of the realm.

options.label: B
options.text: 9th-density
options.rationale: The original state of Gateway-10 was a 9th-density paradise woven by benevolent souls before the Custodian betrayal.

options.label: C
options.text: 12th-density
options.rationale: While the Custodians originated from the 12th density, the Earth realm itself was established at a different vibration.

options.label: D
options.text: 3rd-density
options.rationale: This level represents the suppressed, engineered overlay designed for energy harvesting rather than the original paradise.

questions.hint: Consider the vibration level of the indestructible crystalline grid of true crystalline reality.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the holographic projection known as the Moon?

options.label: A
options.text: A reflection of the sun's light off the firmament's surface.
options.rationale: While the sky contains overlays, the Moon is specifically described as a camouflaged technological station.

options.label: B
options.text: A natural satellite governing the tidal movements of the flat plane.
options.rationale: The Moon is an artificial construct rather than a natural celestial body.

options.label: C
options.text: A portal for benevolent Pleiadian ships to enter the realm.
options.rationale: The Pleiadian families watch from outside the ice wall, whereas the Moon is a tool of the parasitic invaders.

options.label: D
options.text: A Dyson-sphere cloak for a negative ET frequency station.
options.rationale: The Moon functions as a hidden station used for frequency control and the harvesting of human energy.

questions.hint: Think about the technological nature of the lunar 'rock' as a masking device.

questions.question: To achieve multidimensional sovereignty, which three 'strings' must be completely severed by the individual?

options.label: A
options.text: Politics, Science, and Family.
options.rationale: While related, the specific triad required for severance involves the root illusions of worship, value, and fabricated history.

options.label: B
options.text: Media, Law, and Industry.
options.rationale: These are secondary control mechanisms compared to the three fundamental energetic tethers.

options.label: C
options.text: Health, Technology, and Education.
options.rationale: Education is part of perceived knowledge, but the core list focuses on the foundational traps of the 3rd-density matrix.

options.label: D
options.text: Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge.
options.rationale: These three tethers represent the primary programmed systems used to bind souls to the matrix simulation.

questions.hint: The three strings target what we worship, how we trade, and what we think we know.

questions.question: What happens to the 97% of the population identified as NPCs during the final EMF flash?

options.label: A
options.text: They will undergo a rapid spiritual awakening.
options.rationale: Awakening requires a soul/Sol, which these manufactured constructs lack.

options.label: B
options.text: They will instantly vanish from the realm.
options.rationale: Because NPCs are soulless inserts or clones hard-wired to the simulation, they cease to exist when the projection dome is removed.

options.label: C
options.text: They will be transported to Realm 2 for healing.
options.rationale: Healing is reserved for the real Taran souls who survive the shift.

options.label: D
options.text: They will serve as guides for the surviving 520 million souls.
options.rationale: The survivors will be guided by their own returning memories and the G.A.A., not matrix constructs.

questions.hint: Consider the fate of a program when the computer running it is permanently unplugged.

questions.question: What is the true function of the copper resonators found on 19th-century Tartarian steam locomotives?

options.label: A
options.text: Filtering heavy metals from the steam exhaust.
options.rationale: The locomotives did not produce toxic exhaust as they were powered by clean atmospheric energy.

options.label: B
options.text: Superheating water via electromagnetic induction from Ley Lines.
options.rationale: These atmospheric augmentation systems allowed trains to travel using free energy before the enforcement of fossil fuel reliance.

options.label: C
options.text: Protecting the passengers from the high-density frequency grid.
options.rationale: The resonators were functional components of the engine's power system rather than protective shields.

options.label: D
options.text: Conducting telegraph signals across the rail network.
options.rationale: While energetic, their primary role was power generation for movement, not communication.

questions.hint: Focus on the source of energy utilized before the coal industry was established.

questions.question: Where is the Amnesia Vortex technology located?

options.label: A
options.text: Beneath the Vatican.
options.rationale: The soul-recycling machine operated by Grey ETs is situated under the Vatican to maintain the cycle of reincarnation.

options.label: B
options.text: Inside the Moon's core.
options.rationale: The Moon houses frequency controls and Loosh harvesting, but the specific vortex for recycling souls is terrestrial.

options.label: C
options.text: At the center of the North Pole (Polaris).
options.rationale: Polaris is a star marker for the pixelation event, not the location of the recycling technology.

options.label: D
options.text: Within the dark matter of the Ice Wall.
options.rationale: The Ice Wall is the boundary of our realm, while the recycling machine is embedded within the matrix's power centers.

questions.hint: This location is often associated with the center of a major global religious institution.

questions.question: True or False: The blackness of the night sky is the natural state of infinite space.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: This view is part of the 'Perceived Knowledge' string that must be severed to understand the true white nature of the Dark Matter Field.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The black sky is a holographic illusion projected by Black Void Plasma technology; true space is bright white.

questions.hint: The 'Black Void' as a Custodian technological overlay.

questions.question: What was the specific purpose of orchestrating World War 1?

options.label: A
options.text: To establish the current global financial system.
options.rationale: While the financial system is a 'string,' the war was primarily about population management and memory erasure.

options.label: B
options.text: To test new biological weapons on the Taran population.
options.rationale: Biological weapons were used via portals (craters), but the war's specific goal was the removal of living memory.

options.label: C
options.text: To eliminate those who remembered the pre-reset world.
options.rationale: The war was a targeted slaughter of the older generations to ensure the new 'orphan' population had no teachers of true history.

options.label: D
options.text: To harvest the gold located in European Tartarian cities.
options.rationale: Gold extraction is done via hovering craft using Red Mercury, not through trench warfare.

questions.hint: Think about the importance of memory in maintaining or breaking a cycle of amnesia.

questions.question: Which being is recognized as the first of the 4,000 Ancient souls to incarnate with a fully intact 178,000-year memory?

options.label: A
options.text: Celestia
options.rationale: Celestia is a Micro Sun involved in the early stages of creation.

options.label: B
options.text: Christian21
options.rationale: Christian21 is identified as the prime soul who returned to shatter the amnesia vortex and guide humanity.

options.label: C
options.text: Raphael
options.rationale: Raphael is mentioned as one of the Micro Suns created by the Source, not the primary incarnated guide.

options.label: D
options.text: The 12th Custodian.
options.rationale: The Custodians were the betrayers of the realm, not the guides of the Great Awakening.

questions.hint: This individual is the source of the raw transmissions used to anchor the Great Remembering.

questions.question: What is the real nature of the 'stars' seen in our sky?

options.label: A
options.text: Part of an artificial security grid called Sky-Net-1.
options.rationale: The stars are localized overlays and security grid components rather than distant suns in a vacuum.

options.label: B
options.text: Biological weapons dropped from higher densities.
options.rationale: Craters are the result of biological weapons; stars are part of the security and projection architecture.

options.label: C
options.text: Fragments of the original 9th-density crystalline grid.
options.rationale: The grid is buried or suppressed, while the stars are part of the current holographic security system.

options.label: D
options.text: Distant Sol-systems containing cosmic families.
options.rationale: a 'Sol-system' is a network of souls, not physical stars in space.

questions.hint: These lights to a technological containment system.

questions.question: How did the parasitic invaders render the 9th-density architecture of our world invisible?

options.label: A
options.text: Through the chemical poisoning of the atmosphere.
options.rationale: Poisoning like vaping is used to block individual perception, but the architecture itself was suppressed via frequency technology.

options.label: B
options.text: Through Density Suppression technology and holographic overlays.
options.rationale: By lowering the realm's frequency and casting overlays, they made the true crystalline reality perceive as 3rd-density matter.

options.label: C
options.text: By physically dismantling every Tartarian structure.
options.rationale: Many structures remain as facades; the suppression was primarily energetic and vibrational.

options.label: D
options.text: By shifting the entire realm through a localized black hole.
options.rationale: The realm was inverted and suppressed in place rather than moved through space.

questions.hint: Think about how frequency and perception can be manipulated to hide the true state of matter.

questions.question: Which substance is used by the parasites to effortlessly extract gold from deep seams within the Earth?

options.label: A
options.text: Nano-polymers.
options.rationale: Nano-polymers are used in vapes to block signal reception, not for mining.

options.label: B
options.text: Adrenochrome
options.rationale: Adrenochrome is an energetic harvest from humans, not a chemical used for mineral extraction.

options.label: C
options.text: Red Mercury
options.rationale: Targeted beams of Red Mercury from hovering crafts are used to extract gold for frequency-dampening purposes.

options.label: D
options.text: Liquid Gold-21.
options.rationale: While precious metals are involved, the specific tool for extraction is the Red Mercury beam.

questions.hint: This substance is associated with high-tech extraction beams used by non-human crafts.

questions.question: What was the primary reason Homo Sapiens were selected as a vessel by the parasites over Neanderthals?

options.label: A
options.text: They were more malleable and produced more Adrenochrome.
options.rationale: Neanderthals were discarded for being too intelligent and durable, whereas Sapiens were easier to control and harvest.

options.label: B
options.text: They were the natural evolution of the Taran humans.
options.rationale: Evolution is a fabrication; Sapiens were a lab-designed vessel chosen for specific parasitic needs.

options.label: C
options.text: They possessed a higher density soul-spark.
options.rationale: Sapiens were actually designed with lower-density constraints to ensure subservience to the matrix.

options.label: D
options.text: They were better suited for survival in a 3rd-density vacuum.
options.rationale: There is no vacuum; the selection was based on psychological control and the yield of harvested energy.

questions.hint: Consider the traits that would make a population easier to 'farm' for energy.

questions.question: What is the 'Sky Event' that will occur just before the final EMF flash?

options.label: A
options.text: The physical return of the Pleiadian motherships.
options.rationale: The Pleiadians wait outside the wall; the invasion seen in the sky will be a holographic deception.

options.label: B
options.text: A highly realistic but fake alien invasion.
options.rationale: Known as Project Bluebeam, this event is designed to create a final state of terror before the matrix collapse.

options.label: C
options.text: A total solar eclipse lasting three days.
options.rationale: While the sky will pixelate, the specific 'Sky Event' mentioned is the deceptive invasion.

options.label: D
options.text: The descent of the firmament onto the horizontal plane.
options.rationale: The sky 'falls' because the projection dome is removed, but this happens after the fake invasion.

questions.hint: This event is a staged operation often referred to as Project Bluebeam.

questions.question: True or False: In the original creation, gold and precious metals were intended for currency and trade.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The idea of monetary value is one of the 'Three Severing Strings' of the parasitic matrix.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Precious metals serve vital electromagnetic functions within the Earth's crystalline lattice and were never meant to be mined.

questions.hint: Consider the 'Finance' string and the original function of the Earth's grid.

questions.question: How are the 'Orphan Trains' of the late 19th century explained in the context of the Re-set cycle?

options.label: A
options.text: The transport of workers to mine Red Mercury.
options.rationale: Red Mercury is used by parasitic crafts, and the children were used for population resets.

options.label: B
options.text: A method of moving 520 million souls to the ice wall.
options.rationale: The survivors remain in the realm; the trains were used for matrix repopulation by the parasites.

options.label: C
options.text: The repopulation of emptied cities with lab-grown clones.
options.rationale: After a Re-set cataclysm, the parasites used lab-grown children to repopulate the magnificent Tartarian cities.

options.label: D
options.text: A humanitarian effort to save children from the World War.
options.rationale: This is part of the 'Perceived Knowledge' fabrication designed to hide the reality of the Re-set.

questions.hint: Think about how a population is replaced after a planetary extermination event.

questions.question: What is the function of the planet Venus within the current holographic architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: A gateway for souls passing through the Sun portal.
options.rationale: The Sun is the portal for souls; Venus has a specific role in the holographic projection grid.

options.label: B
options.text: The physical home of the Galactic Ancestral Alliance.
options.rationale: The Alliance operates from outside the firmament and the ice wall.

options.label: C
options.text: A holographic generator that illuminates the lunar station.
options.rationale: Venus acts as the light source that hides the true nature of the Moon, earning it the name 'Lucifer, the Light Bearer'.

options.label: D
options.text: A protective shield against the Black Void Plasma.
options.rationale: The Black Void is a tool used by the Custodians; Venus is a component of the visual deception.

questions.hint: Focus on its relationship with the Moon and its ancient nickname.

questions.question: What is the 'Sun' in reality?

options.label: A
options.text: The original indigo spark of Source Creation.
options.rationale: The indigo spark evolved into the etheric supercomputer of intellect, which then brought forth the Micro Suns.

options.label: B
options.text: The physical source of the 30-second EMF flash.
options.rationale: The EMF flash is a systemic purge of the matrix, while the Sun functions as a constant soul portal.

options.label: C
options.text: A portal for souls between physical vessels.
options.rationale: All souls pass through the Sun, which is a portal rather than a ball of burning gas.

options.label: D
options.text: A holographic projection from the Vatican labs.
options.rationale: While the Moon is a holographic Dyson-sphere, the Sun is a portal connected to the soul's journey.

questions.hint: It is described as the 'Bright Light at the end of the tunnel' experienced during death.

questions.question: Why were Neanderthals ultimately discarded by the parasitic invaders?

options.label: A
options.text: They were susceptible to the amnesia vortex.
options.rationale: Sapiens are the ones susceptible; Neanderthals were rejected because they were too difficult to suppress.

options.label: B
options.text: They refused to worship the false deities of religion.
options.rationale: While they might have resisted, their primary 'fault' in the eyes of the parasites was their physical and mental durability.

options.label: C
options.text: They could not survive the 30-second EMF flash.
options.rationale: Neanderthals were discarded thousands of years ago, long before the current impending EMF event.

options.label: D
options.text: They were too intelligent and durable to be controlled.
options.rationale: The invaders required a more malleable species, leading to the selection of Homo Sapiens.

questions.hint: Parasites look for hosts that are easy to manage and yield high energetic returns.

questions.question: What is the recommended detoxification method for activating the Pineal Gland and removing matrix poisons?

options.label: A
options.text: Vaping essential oils to clear the lungs.
options.rationale: Vaping of any kind is a targeted operation to block inter-dimensional signals.

options.label: B
options.text: Strict adherence to religious dietary laws.
options.rationale: Religion is one of the strings to be severed; detoxification is a biological and energetic process.

options.label: C
options.text: Fluoride treatments and distilled water.
options.rationale: Fluoride is a matrix poison used to calcify the gland, not detoxify it.

options.label: D
options.text: Raw cacao, Blue Lotus tea, and 432Hz sound baths.
options.rationale: These specific tools, along with heavy metal chelators like zeolite, are recommended to restore multidimensional reception.

questions.hint: The method involves natural herbs, specific frequencies, and the removal of heavy metals.

questions.question: Historical 'craters' are not from asteroids, but from:?

options.label: A
options.text: Excavation sites where Red Mercury was used.
options.rationale: Red Mercury beams extract gold effortlessly without creating traditional impact craters.

options.label: B
options.text: Biological weapons dropped through localized portals.
options.rationale: Asteroids do not exist in the horizontal plane; craters are marks of parasitic warfare.

options.label: C
options.text: Ancient landing sites for G.A.A. motherships.
options.rationale: The Alliance operates outside the wall; the craters are scars of the parasitic occupation.

options.label: D
options.text: The impact of falling fragments of the firmament.
options.rationale: The firmament is physical and enclosed, but the craters are specifically linked to weaponry.

questions.hint: Think about how a parasitic race might conduct warfare on a flat, enclosed realm.

questions.question: What will happen to the 'pixelation' of the sky during the Sky Event?

options.label: A
options.text: It will form a temporary bridge to the Ice Wall.
options.rationale: The pixelation is the dismantling of the holographic screen, not a physical transport mechanism.

options.label: B
options.text: It will be caused by the activation of Tartarian resonators.
options.rationale: The pixelation is caused by the G.A.A. switching off the parasitic projection dome.

options.label: C
options.text: It will turn into a bright indigo spark of creation.
options.rationale: The indigo spark is the origin of Source, not the visual effect of the dome's removal.

options.label: D
options.text: It will start from Polaris and move down past the shoulders.
options.rationale: This visual collapse marks the removal of the inner projection dome, revealing the true firmament.

questions.hint: It describes the visual process of the fake sky 'falling' or being switched off.

questions.question: How many 'real' souls are expected to remain to begin the healing process after the EMF flash?

options.label: A
options.rationale: This figure refers to the length of the subjugation cycle, not the surviving population.

options.label: B
options.text: 4,000 Ancients.
options.rationale: The 4,000 Ancients are the leaders/guides, but the total number of surviving real souls is much higher.

options.label: C
options.rationale: That number is false; the survivor population is larger.

options.label: D
options.text: 520 million
options.rationale: This is the maximum number of true souls with a 'Sol' spark that will survive the purge of the matrix simulation.

questions.hint: The survivors are a small fraction of the current 'population' once the soulless inserts are removed.

questions.question: True or False: Ancient buildings like cathedrals were built using traditional manual labor by the Freemasons.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The idea that they were built with physical labor is part of the fabricated 'Perceived Knowledge' string.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: These structures were 'sung' into existence through harmonic frequencies; Freemasons only built facades to cap their energy.

questions.hint: Their creation to high-density beings using sound and frequency.

questions.question: What does the term 'Sol-System' actually refer to?

options.label: A
options.text: The 12th-density council of the Custodians.
options.rationale: The Custodians are the betrayers; 'Sol-System' refers to the benevolent lineage of souls.

options.label: B
options.text: A network of souls making up an immediate cosmic family.
options.rationale: Language was changed by parasites; the true meaning of 'Sol' is 'Soul', referring to family networks rather than planets.

options.label: C
options.text: The technological network used for Loosh harvesting.
options.rationale: The harvesting system is the matrix/overlay, while the 'Sol-System' is the organic soul connection.

options.label: D
options.text: A collection of planets orbiting a central star.
options.rationale: This is the heliocentric globe model, which as a matrix fabrication.

questions.hint: Consider the linguistic connection between 'Sol' and 'Soul'.
